title: How Long Do Trucks Really Last? The 250,000-Mile Data (2027)
description:
How long trucks really last: the 250,000-mile studies, which pickups reach them, the average age of vehicles on U.S. roads, and what makes the difference. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:47 How old America's vehicles get
5:23 Who reaches 250,000 miles
9:43 The F-150 paradox
11:54 Heavy-duty vs half-ton
14:53 What ends a truck's life
17:38 How to make a truck last
20:06 The verdict and checklist for 2027

Sources:
- TFLcar, vehicles most likely to reach 250,000 miles (Sept 2026): https://tflcar.com/2026/09/vehicles-most-likely-to-make-250000-miles-study/
- MoneyLion, pickup trucks running strong after 20 years: https://moneylion.com/trending/money/pickup-trucks-running-strong-20-years
- Auto Remarketing, vehicle age report: https://www.autoremarketing.com/?p=62363
- Repairer Driven News, average vehicle age (May 2025): https://www.repairerdrivennews.com/2025/05/28/average-passenger-car-age-now-14-5-years-nearly-13-years-overall/
- Auto Dealer Today, vehicles getting up there: https://www.autodealertodaymagazine.com/news/vehicles-getting-up-there
- Work Truck Online, which truck models last over 200k miles: https://www.worktruckonline.com/news/which-truck-models-last-over-200k-miles
- Work Truck Online, which trucks will last over 250k miles: https://www.worktruckonline.com/news/study-shows-which-trucks-will-last-over-250k-miles
